crossRefs.note: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the…
You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you…
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…

translations.web: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
translations.bsb: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
translations.kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
translations.asv: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life Shall abide among the wise.
